item.title: Nick Schmaltz nets hat trick as Mammoth overpower Canucks 6-2
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Nick Schmaltz had his second hat trick of the season and added an assist for a four-point night in the Utah Mammoth's 6-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Monday.

item.title: Nylander nets three points to lead Maple Leafs to 4-2 win over Flames
item.description: CALGARY — William Nylander scored his 18th goal of the season and added two assists to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 4-2 NHL victory over the Calgary Flames on Monday.

item.title: Trial of the son of Norway's crown princess on rape and other charges opening in Oslo
item.description: OSLO, Norway (AP) — The son of Norway's crown princess is going on trial Tuesday on charges that include rape, opening proceedings that are expected to last several weeks in a case that has cast a shadow on the royal family's image.

item.title: NHL roundup: Zucker scores the winner as surging Sabres pounce on Panthers 5-3
item.description: SUNRISE, Fla. (AP) — Jason Zucker broke a 3-3 tie on a power play at 5:31 of the third period and the Buffalo Sabres beat the two-time defending Stanley Cup champion Florida Panthers 5-3 on Monday.
